concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-plugins-netsuite-set-up-adyen-customer-area]] — 2023-modified NetSuite ecommerce Customer Area setup guide captured 2026-09-15 for API-credential roles/account scope, Cash Sale versus Sales Order capture delay, and NetSuite-postback Standard webhook; configuration is not outcome proof.
warnings: The adyen-netsuite concept is proposed by the NetSuite overview job; apply this reciprocal link after that new concept is promoted.

Basic authentication password in this page belongs to the API credential. The page does not define webhook HMAC or webhook Basic-auth settings, and a saved webhook is not evidence of delivered/verified notifications.
Capture-delay choice is conditional on NetSuite Cash Sales versus Sales Orders and does not prove payment capture, order fulfillment or settlement.
